title: The Minnesota paradox
text:
A thoughtful editorial on the Minnesota Paradox, a historically mostly white state with a strong civic, liberal sensibility also with more recent history of welcoming immigrants of many flavors, rising tensions, ambivalence, yet remaining largely liberal. And offering a lens into 2 opposing world views!! Fascinating look.

Also, an interesting editorial:  https://www.nytimes.com/2026/01/19/opinion/trump-minneapolis-ice.html?unlocked_article_code=1.FlA.4qRr.hBBbdQ1tv2fn&smid=url-share
